Overview

Astana (Nur-Sultan) is a city in Akmola with a population of 1,350,000. Kazakhstan’s futuristic capital on the steppe, known for its bold architecture, government buildings, and extreme winters. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.0.
